title: wmem: Remove strbuf max size parameter
description:
This parameter introduces complexity, UTF-8 errors and it's
unclear what the use case is to impose a ceiling in octets
on the length of a string.

If necessary the same effect can easily be achieved using
wmem_strbuf_truncate().

Rename wmem_strbuf_sized_new() with a more readable name.

notes.body:
> This parameter introduces complexity, UTF-8 errors and it's unclear what the use case is to impose a ceiling in octets on the length of a string.

The idea was to limit the damage from runaway appending, such as a loop creating a gigabyte item label. If that causes more problems than it solves, I have no objection to removing the max size.

commits_data.message:
wmem: Remove strbuf max size parameter

This parameter was introduced as a safeguard for bugs
that generate an unbounded string but its utility for
that purpose is doubtful and the way it is being used
creates problems with invalid truncation of UTF-8
strings.

Rename wmem_strbuf_sized_new() with a better name.
